prompt:
Create one complete native 1536x1024 terrain-only base for a Chinese wuxia 2.5D RPG mountain road. Use a high three-quarter camera, hand-painted Hong Kong comic game rendering, clean dark ink contours, pale ochre dirt, mossy gray rock, muted jade bamboo greens, and warm upper-right daylight.

Composition is for active exploration: a broad clear dirt road begins at the lower-left quarter, travels through the lower middle, then bends gradually uphill to reach the upper-right edge. The visible road must remain continuous and at least 240 pixels wide along the whole route. Shape the road so there are open, level dirt shoulders around the left-middle, center-lower, and center areas for later placement of a stone tablet, a chest, and an encounter marker. Frame the road only with distant bamboo slopes, low grass, scattered natural rocks, shallow ravine edges, and cliff faces. Keep the playable route readable in a single glance.

This is only the terrain base of a modular scene. Do not include any buildings, village gate, fence, bridge, signpost, stone tablet, chest, cart, barrel, lantern, weapon, corpse, camp, shrine, statue, person, NPC, enemy, animal, text, label, arrow, UI, readable writing, watermark, or foreground object that would obstruct later module placement. No parchment border, no collage panels, no cut-off road, and no large tree or bamboo cluster crossing the road.
